scripts.lint:test: eslint app lib prisma scripts tests e2e --max-warnings=0
scripts.handoff:preflight: npm run secrets:scan && npm run handoff:checklist
scripts.test:e2e: npm run test:e2e:launch-production && npm run test:e2e:local-review
scripts.test:e2e:local-review: npm run db:recreate && npm run prisma:migrate:local && PAT_ENABLE_LOCAL_REVIEW_AUTH=1 PAT_LOCAL_REVIEW_PASSWORD=pat-local-review npm run seed:baseline && PAT_ENABLE_LOCAL_REVIEW_AUTH=1 PAT_LOCAL_REVIEW_PASSWORD=pat-local-review npm run seed:pat-runtime && PLAYWRIGHT_PORT=3001 PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3001 AUTH_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3001 NEXTAUTH_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3001 PAT_ENABLE_LOCAL_REVIEW_AUTH=1 PAT_LOCAL_REVIEW_PASSWORD=pat-local-review AUTH_SECRET=pat-local-auth-secret playwright test e2e/local-review-auth.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:launch-production: npm run db:recreate && npm run prisma:migrate:local && PAT_BOOTSTRAP_DEFAULT_PASSWORD=pat-bootstrap-pass npm run seed:baseline && PAT_BOOTSTRAP_DEFAULT_PASSWORD=pat-bootstrap-pass npm run seed:pat-runtime && PAT_ENABLE_BOOTSTRAP_USERS=1 PAT_BOOTSTRAP_DEFAULT_PASSWORD=pat-bootstrap-pass PAT_BOOTSTRAP_VENDOR_EMAIL=vendor.bootstrap@example.com PAT_BOOTSTRAP_FIRM_EMAIL=firm.bootstrap@example.com PAT_BOOTSTRAP_INDIVIDUAL_EMAIL=individual.bootstrap@example.com PAT_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_EMAIL=admin.bootstrap@example.com npm run seed:bootstrap-users && npm run check:seed-hygiene:production && PLAYWRIGHT_PORT=3001 PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3001 AUTH_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3001 NEXTAUTH_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3001 AUTH_SECRET=pat-local-auth-secret PAT_BOOTSTRAP_DEFAULT_PASSWORD=pat-bootstrap-pass PAT_BOOTSTRAP_VENDOR_EMAIL=vendor.bootstrap@example.com PAT_BOOTSTRAP_FIRM_EMAIL=firm.bootstrap@example.com PAT_BOOTSTRAP_INDIVIDUAL_EMAIL=individual.bootstrap@example.com PAT_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_EMAIL=admin.bootstrap@example.com playwright test e2e/pat-critical-paths.spec.ts e2e/launch-auth-production.spec.ts --grep 'redirects signed-out users away from protected PAT pages and APIs|keeps local review controls hidden in production-style e2e mode|launch auth production path'
scripts.db:recreate: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d db && npm run db:wait
scripts.check:launch: npm run check:pat-runtime && npm run check:capability-mappings && npm run check:product-commercial-contracts
scripts.check:repo: npm run lint:repo && npm run typecheck && npm run build
scripts.smoke:launch: npm run smoke:score-unlock-contract && npm run smoke:firm-modular-runtime && npm run smoke:capability-write && npm run smoke:vendor-alignment-catalog && npm run smoke:vendor-product-signal
